displayName: NBD Pro — Turnstile token arrived on a real lead (turnstileTokenPresent=true)

documentation.content:
A public lead reached submitPublicLead WITH a Cloudflare Turnstile token. This is the signal the enforcement decision waits on (documentation/runbooks/TURNSTILE-SETUP.md, 'Verifying step 3'). It is good news, not an incident.

What it proves: a real browser on a public form minted a token and the client attached it. What it does NOT prove:
  1. That the token is valid. The server logs !!body.turnstileToken — presence only — and nothing verifies tokens while TURNSTILE_SECRET is unset, so a hand-crafted POST can trip this too.
  2. That every surface works. The log carries kind + doc id, not the page. Open the lead doc by that id in the kind's collection (contact → contact_leads, which the /areas and /services quick forms post as; inspect → inspect_leads; estimate → estimate_leads; guide → guide_leads; storm → storm_alert_subscribers; free_roof → free_roof_entries — see functions/handlers/integrations.js) and read its `source`: '/inspect', 'page-form:/areas/...', 'page-form:/services/...'. The rollout wants a true from /inspect AND from at least one /areas or /services quick form.

Do NOT set TURNSTILE_SECRET because this fired. Enforcement is Jo's separate decision, taken on a token RATE, not one event:
  gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.message="submitPublicLead"' --project nobigdeal-pro --freshness=30d --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.kind,jsonPayload.turnstileTokenPresent)'

Created 2026-09-13, right after #1542 keyed all 181 lead surfaces. It was the first alert policy actually live in this project (the other monitoring/*.json files were never applied — STABILITY-AUDIT-2026-09-04). Once enough trues have been seen, disable it rather than let it page on every lead.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="submitpubliclead" AND jsonPayload.message="submitPublicLead" AND jsonPayload.turnstileTokenPresent=true
